description: PostgreSQL MCP Server — query databases, inspect schemas, and analyze data using natural language

steps: Ensure PostgreSQL is running and accessible
Provide the connection string in the args
setup.notes: Start with a read-only database role to prevent accidental mutations. The connection string can include user, password, host, port, and database name.

use_cases: Query tables and inspect database schemas
Ask natural language questions about your data
Generate reports and summaries from database content
Debug data issues and explore relationships
